hero.label: Made for Contrario
hero.headline: I want to help Contrario become the default hiring layer for high-growth startups.
hero.subheadline: Agentic recruiting is one of the few AI applications where speed genuinely changes outcomes, and Contrario is attacking that problem at exactly the right moment. I come from the BDR trenches and B2B marketing, so I understand both how to open doors and how to earn trust with technical buyers. A Founding GTM seat at Contrario is where I want to build my career.

whyCompany.title: AI agents plus human recruiters is the right architecture for this market
whyCompany.body: Most AI recruiting tools either go fully automated and lose candidate trust, or stay fully human and lose speed. Contrario's hybrid model of pairing expert recruiters with AI agents is a smarter wedge into high-growth companies that cannot afford a bad hire or a slow process. That positioning gives GTM a real, defensible story to tell.

whyCompany.title: Founding GTM means the playbook is still being written
whyCompany.body: Contrario is at the stage where the ICP, the outbound motion, and the messaging all need to be figured out by whoever is in the room. That is not a liability to me, it is the whole point. I want to be the person who builds the first repeatable GTM process, not someone who inherits one.

whyCompany.title: I have already done this kind of zero-to-revenue work at Copygen.ai
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences and helped the company close 15 to 20 paying clients as a BDR. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy learning how to market to sophisticated buyers. Contrario needs someone who can prospect, qualify, and learn the customer fast, and that is exactly what I have been training to do.

quote: I spent over a year doing BDR work at an early AI startup and the thing I kept thinking was: I want to be the person who designs this motion, not just executes it. Contrario is my shot at that.
